turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I keep waking up at four and I can't fall back asleep. Any ideas?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: If you're awake for more than twenty minutes, get up and do something calm in dim light, like reading. Lying there stressed usually makes it worse.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: So I volunteered to make my sister's wedding cake. In a moment of madness.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's a big, generous job. Are you set on a real stacked tiered cake, or would a small display cake plus sheet cakes in the kitchen work?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One sec, I'm going to talk with my neighbor. Please wait until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Rosa, the guy downstairs is selling his old console. Two controllers and five games.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A hundred and twenty. Is that a good deal?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Depends which games. And check the disc drive actually works.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Good point. Would you come with me to look at it?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Sure, after dinner. I'll do the haggling, you go too soft.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. The wedding cake question is still open. Which version?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Real tiers. It's my sister, I want it to be special.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then get dowels and cake boards for support, and do a practice cake a few weeks before.
